notes.subject: Mene
notes.rationale: The inscribed word is itself a counting verb: Eloa has counted/numbered the kingdom.

notes.subject: מנא/מנה
notes.rationale: Aramaic pun — the written word MENE is repeated as the verb 'he numbered'; Bamanankan keeps the name and repeats 'jate' but the sound-play is lost.

notes.subject: ka a ban
notes.rationale: והשלמה is literally 'and completed/restored it'; rendered as 'brought it to an end', the sense all versions take.

translation: Nin ye kuma in kɔrɔfɔli ye: Mene — Eloa ye i masaya jate, ka a ban.
